items.text: Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten did not practice Wednesday due to foot/ankle injuries. Injury resurfaced in prior loss; availability for Week 12 in question.
items.why: Foot/ankle aggravation from recent game; exam showed nothing major but practice missed.
items.implication: Monitor for inactive/GTD; handcuff or backup RBs rise if OUT.
items.opportunity: Snap/carry share open if limited or out.

items.text: Chiefs officially ruled out RB Kenneth Walker for Thursday night vs Bills due to groin injury. Rookie Emmett Johnson will start in his place for the third straight game.
items.why: Groin injury; limited in prior practice then ruled out.
items.implication: Handcuff/start Emmett Johnson; Walker managers must pivot for TNF.
items.opportunity: Full RB workload likely to Johnson again.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving this week vs Carolina. Since Week 5 only Gibbs and CMC have averaged more PPG among RBs.
items.why: Elite recent PPG + soft CAR matchup.
items.opportunity: Volume and efficiency vs weak run D.

items.text: Citing Graziano on Travis Etienne: could see disappointing snaps/routes down stretch but reasonably high carry count. Favorable playoff schedule vs ARZ/ATL Weeks 16/17.
items.why: Beat/context on role split; volume via carries over receiving.
items.implication: RB2/flex with carry floor and schedule upside; don't expect full three-down.
items.opportunity: Carry share floor; monitor snap/route trends for pass-game fade.

items.text: Derrick Henry target share jumped from <6% (1.3 rec/g first 9 games) to 12% and 4.5 receptions in 2 games with Jacoby Brissett. Raises PPR floor.
items.why: Pass-game involvement spike with new QB.
items.implication: Safer PPR RB1/2; floor elevated beyond pure rush.

items.text: Puka Nacua (and TE Terrance Ferguson) out for the season after knee surgery; confirmed in Week 12 preview. 4-5 month recovery, misses playoffs.
items.why: MCL surgery; timeline 4-5 months per sources/McVay.
items.implication: Drop in all formats; Rams WR corps thinned long-term.
items.opportunity: Remaining Rams WRs (Atwell etc.) and Adams when healthy see boosted roles/routes.

items.text: Colts cut Daniel Jones; Anthony Richardson set to start. Previewed as key Week 12 development.
items.why: Post-blowout decision for best interest; AR gets full practice week.
items.implication: Indy skill players (Pittman, Downs, JT, Warren TE) face dual-threat QB variance; monitor rush/pass rates.
items.opportunity: Potential designed runs and deep shots change usage.

items.text: Davante Adams longshot for Week 13, targeting mid-December return from hamstring. Not expected Week 12 vs Packers; practice window not open.
items.why: Hamstring surgery recovery; McVay/Rapoport updates push timeline back.
items.implication: Stash only in deep/IR leagues; no immediate help for Rams pass catchers void.
items.opportunity: Continued elevated looks for remaining Rams WRs until return.

items.text: Bo Nix on HATE list this week. Expecting heavy Jonah Coleman (RB) usage vs Pittsburgh; hasn't seen enough rushing from Nix. Outside top 20.
items.why: Run-heavy script expected; limited QB rushing upside observed.

items.text: DeVonta Smith saw 57% target share in Week 11. Averages 36% on season, 50% of Eagles end-zone targets. Role elite despite injury-hit season.
items.why: Massive target concentration when healthy/Hurts available.
items.implication: WR1 upside if volume sustains; buy-low if available.

items.text: Ladd McConkey return: season-high 38% target share last week, 20.7 FP. When >=20% share averages 17.5 PPG. Solid if stays healthy.
items.implication: WR2/flex with upside if health holds.

items.text: Jaylen Warren only 51% rush attempts since Dowdle return (Week 6), low target share, RB20 utilization. D'Andre Swift 47% snaps/39% rushes with Monangai back, sub-10% targets often. Both mid/low RB2.
items.why: Committee dilution confirmed by snap/attempt/target shares.
items.implication: Temper expectations; RB2/flex only, not RB1.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka last among 45 WRs with 50+ targets in YPT (5.0). Under 50 rec yards since Week 3; under 12 PPR in 17 of last 20 games dating to last year.
items.implication: Fade/start only in desperation; efficiency concerns.

items.text: Trey McBride 39% target share (19 targets) over past 2 weeks with backup QBs, but aDOT only 3 yards, 1 target 10+ air yards. Volume keeps top-5 TE PPR but yards/reception and FP down (11.8 avg).
items.why: High volume but short-area only without preferred QB.
items.implication: Still start TE1 but temper boom expectations.
items.opportunity: Target volume floor intact; low aDOT caps YAC/big plays.
